Following the news that Michelle Monaghan (True Detective, Gone Baby Gone) will join Your Friends & Neighbors season 3 as a series regular, Deadline has exclusively reported another addition to the show’s cast. Here are the details.

Joshua Jackson to join Your Friends & Neighbors

According to Deadline, Joshua Jackson (Dawson’s Creek, Fringe) has been confirmed as a series regular for the next season of Your Friends & Neighbors. Apple TV confirmed the news with a post on its X account.

The news comes on the eve of the season 2 finale, capping a second ten-episode run.

In addition to stars such as Jon Hamm (Mad Men, The Morning Show), Amanda Peet (The Whole Nine Yards, Identity), and Olivia Munn (The Newsroom, X-Men: Apocalypse), the show added James Marsden (Paradise, Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice) for its second season.

Apple confirmed the renewal of Your Friends & Neighbors for a third season on the eve of the premiere of season 2, but has yet to share details on the timeline for the show’s return after tomorrow’s finale.
